name: Old Hindi Bollywood / Retro Nostalgia
description: Old Hindi Bollywood songs, especially evergreen 50s/60s/70s/80s/90s/early-2000s emotional, romantic, heartbreak and nostalgia reels.
new_song_exception: Only allow a new release when it is explicitly a remix/revival of an old Bollywood song and the recommendation is labelled as a retro crossover.
default_strategy: Niche fit first, account performance second, current discovery signal third.
